root_text:
You Need to Know📢📢📢

🩺HMPV is NOT a notifiable disease like Covid-19 or influenza.

🎯The symptoms of HMPV are similar to a cold or flu, and it is one of several viruses often lumped under a broad definition of the “common cold”
